steps.what: List stored video and paper performance records
Keep and review paper, computerized, and video records
Review athlete and opposing team performance

outputs: filed copy of signed record review v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} lists stored paper and video performance records and does not read injury text. The coach keeps and reviews the paper, computerized, and video records, including opposing team performance. A later job files the signed review. It does not add a tracking feed and it does not score an athlete.
tasks.previous_blocker: Paper, computer files, and video lived in different places.
tasks.enabler_now: Record identifier, medium, and record date are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The review stays with the coach.
tasks.human_edge: The coach decides what the record shows.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week on the review, not on listing files.

reach.task: Use only the review the coach signed

evidence.claim: Digest [S16] says injury notes are health data. This design does not read injury notes and does not automate a health judgement.
Digest [S17] says tracking a club's own players needs works council consent. This design does not build a tracking dashboard.
The executive digest says ranking players to sign fits that high-risk reading. This design does not rank players.

assumptions: Record identifier, medium, record date, and note type are stored on the performance record. The performance record produces them. A row whose stored type is injury is left out and its text is not read. A blank record date is not reviewed as current. No new tracking feed is added.
Native configuration of the performance record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach keeping and reviewing paper, computerized, and video records.

incremental.description: Refresh record identifier, medium, and record date when the record layout changes, and drop a review the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many record dates are blank. The high end assumes record identifier, medium, and record date are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assemble stored scouting notes excluding injury text
Provide player assessments and athlete recommendations
Identify future recruitment locations and targeted individuals
Draft scouting reports that detail stored notes

loop.purpose: Summarise stored scouting notes into a report without ranking anyone.
loop.input: Stored scouting note rows, the coach outline, and the coach target note.
loop.output: A draft report whose every claim restates one of those rows.
loop.check: Every number matches a stored row, and every claim is a restatement of that row.
loop.stop: Stop when a number or a claim has no row.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot restate a variable scouting note.

steps.what: Check each claim restates a stored note
File only the signed scouting report
outputs: filed copy of signed scouting report v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} assembles stored scouting notes and leaves out a row whose stored type is injury, without reading that text. The coach provides the player assessments and recommendations, and identifies the locations and individuals to be targeted. A bounded draft restates those rows and stops when a claim has no row. The coach checks that restatement. A later job files only the signed report. It does not rank a player.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scouting notes were summarised without a check back to the row.
tasks.enabler_now: Note identifier, note text, and note type are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The recommendation and the target stay with the coach.
tasks.human_edge: The coach decides the report is faithful.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week on the check, not on assembling rows.

reach.task: Use only the report the coach signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says scouting is a model summary of tagged video, and the scout signs. This design summarises stored notes only, and the coach signs.
Digest [S11] says a system that filters or evaluates candidates, including for self-employment, is high-risk. This design does not filter or rank candidates.
Digest [S12] says those duties apply from 2 December 2027.
Digest [S16] says injury notes are health data. This design does not read injury notes and does not automate a health judgement.
The executive digest says ranking players to sign fits that high-risk reading. This design does not rank players.

assumptions: Note identifier, note text, and note type are stored on the scouting record. The scouting record produces them. A row whose stored type is injury is left out and its text is not read. A claim with no row is not left in the draft. The draft does not rank a player.
Native configuration of the scouting record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
The coach writes the recommendation and the target before the draft runs.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach checking that each claim restates a stored note.

incremental.description: Refresh note identifier, note text, and note type when the scouting layout changes, and drop a report the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many notes have no matching claim. The high end assumes note identifier, note text, and note type are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Flag equipment short of the stored minimum
Select, acquire, and store the equipment
Issue equipment and other materials as necessary
Send only the signed equipment order
outputs: filed copy of signed equipment order v1

tasks.design: A job in {PROCUREMENT} flags an item only when the stored quantity is below the stored minimum. The coach selects, acquires, stores, and issues the equipment and other materials. A later job sends only the signed order. It does not order by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Shortages were noticed when a cupboard was empty.
tasks.enabler_now: Item identifier, quantity, and minimum are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting and issuing stay with the coach.
tasks.human_edge: The coach decides what to order and what to hand out.

ambition.what: Sign the equipment order the day quantity falls below the stored minimum.

tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week on the cupboard, not on the short list.

reach.task: Receive only the order the coach signed

evidence.claim: Selecting and issuing equipment stays with the coach. A short list is only a quantity below a stored minimum.

assumptions: Item identifier, quantity, and minimum are stored on the equipment record. The equipment record produces them. An item is short only when the stored quantity is below the stored minimum. A blank minimum is not short. A blank quantity is not treated as zero.
Native configuration of the equipment record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
The send is the signed order and no other item.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach selecting, acquiring, and storing the equipment.

incremental.description: Refresh item identifier, quantity, and minimum when the stock layout changes, and drop an order the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many minimums are blank. The high end assumes item identifier, quantity, and minimum are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The coach spends the week on the field, with the athletes, and on the signed note. A stored list, an unnamed slot, and filing that signature can move. The coach still runs the session, chooses the people, and signs the note.
reach: An athlete trains only on the session the coach signed.
A parent sees only the note the coach signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a schedule that names a player the coach did not assign.
Reject a scouting claim that does not restate a stored note.
Reject a letter or an order the coach has not signed.
role.ambitious_version: A signed schedule or report can be filed the same day, and the coach still owns the field.
